comment: Packages that cannot be built purely from source. Every non-source package must appear here with a reason; scripts/verify-exceptions.sh fails otherwise. 'kind' values: prebuilt (upstream binary), wheel (PyPI wheel-only), closed (no source), bootstrap (self-hosting), channel-prebuilt (supplied prebuilt by a channel), embedded-prebuilt (binary embedded in a hash-pinned source).

exceptions.name: sing-box (libcronet.so)
exceptions.reason: NaiveProxy needs a prebuilt libcronet.so, embedded in the hash-pinned sagernet/cronet-go Go module.

exceptions.name: porcupine-for-hermes
exceptions.reason: Picovoice Porcupine wake-word engine is closed source.

exceptions.name: playwright-for-hermes
exceptions.reason: PyPI publishes playwright only as wheels bundling a Node driver.

exceptions.name: ua-parser-builtins-for-hermes
exceptions.reason: PyPI publishes ua-parser-builtins only as wheels.

exceptions.name: bun-for-hermes
exceptions.reason: Bun's self-hosting build requires a prebuilt bootstrap binary.

exceptions.name: camoufox-browser-for-hermes
exceptions.reason: Camoufox is distributed only as a prebuilt Firefox fork.

exceptions.name: hermes-electron-desktop
exceptions.reason: Electron is distributed prebuilt by the nonguix channel.

exceptions.name: strata-cuda (CUDA toolkit)
exceptions.reason: The CUDA 13.0 toolkit this engine links is distributed prebuilt by the guix-hpc-non-free channel (via guix-science-nonfree) from NVIDIA's non-free .run installer and is non-substitutable; the Strata engine sources themselves are built from source.

exceptions.name: impit-linux-x64-gnu-for-hermes
exceptions.reason: impit ships only a prebuilt Linux x64 gnu .node addon.

exceptions.name: moldflow-insight-thinclient
exceptions.reason: Autodesk Moldflow Insight 2027 thin-client is distributed only as a proprietary prebuilt installer (Autodesk EULA); the user supplies the archive and the package is non-substitutable.

exceptions.name: adsk-licensing
exceptions.reason: Autodesk Licensing Service is distributed only as a proprietary prebuilt RPM (Autodesk EULA); the user supplies the archive and the package is non-substitutable.

exceptions.name: kilocode (native npm payloads)
exceptions.reason: The bundled CLI includes precompiled native npm payloads that ship no source: @opentui/core-linux-x64, @parcel/watcher-linux-x64-glibc, @lydell/node-pty-linux-x64, @ff-labs/fff-bin-linux-x64-gnu and the tree-sitter bash/powershell grammars. All are hash-pinned origins in kilocode-lock.scm; the loader, wrapper and app code are built from source.

exceptions.name: ghidra
exceptions.reason: Ghidra is deployed from the official Apache-2.0 release distribution (hash-pinned zip). An offline Gradle source build would require vendoring the entire Gradle plugin/Maven dependency graph plus the external ghidra.bin repository, which is impractical on this host (direct GitHub and Gradle plugin-portal access is throttled to a few KB/s). The launchers and native helpers are adapted to Guix (store loader, store bash, pinned OpenJDK).

exceptions.name: bun-for-opencode
exceptions.reason: Bun's self-hosting build requires a prebuilt bootstrap binary; opencode 1.19/2.1 require Bun 1.4.4.

exceptions.name: opencode-v1 (native npm payloads)
exceptions.reason: The source build embeds precompiled native npm payloads that ship no source: @opentui/core-linux-x64, bun-pty, @parcel/watcher-linux-x64-glibc, @lydell/node-pty-linux-x64, @ff-labs/fff-bin-linux-x64-gnu and tree-sitter grammars. All are hash-pinned origins in opencode-v1-lock.scm; the CLI/TUI/app code is built from source.

exceptions.name: opencode-v2 (native npm payloads)
exceptions.reason: The source build embeds precompiled native npm payloads that ship no source: @opentui/core-linux-x64, bun-pty, @opencode-ai/pty-linux-x64-gnu, @parcel/watcher-linux-x64-glibc, @lydell/node-pty-linux-x64, @yuuang/ffi-rs-linux-x64-gnu and tree-sitter grammars. All are hash-pinned origins in opencode-v2-lock.scm; the CLI/TUI/app code is built from source.
